title: SF State’s preschool operator refunded $29,156 after an eligibility review

beats.text: Two families at the San Francisco State University preschool met the local pilot income limit.
Their income exceeded the limit for the state grant.

visual.line: Their income exceeded the limit for the state grant

beats.text: Auditors estimated that $15,000 in funding related to those two families.
Management then reviewed every initial certification for the year and found six families certified in error.

visual.line: Management then reviewed every initial certification for the year and found six families certified in error

beats.text: The audit removed 947 days from certified enrollment.
The attendance figure stayed at 2,705 days.

visual.line: The attendance figure stayed at 2,705 days

beats.text: The error concerned which children the state grant could cover.

visual.line: The error concerned which children the state grant could cover

beats.text: Staff began using the state income limit in October 2015.
The next audit describes a second reviewer checking the eligibility checklist.

visual.line: The next audit describes a second reviewer checking the eligibility checklist

beats.text: Associated Students refunded $29,156 to the California Department of Education.
The following year’s grant accounts record the payment against the prior year’s preschool grant.

visual.line: The following year’s grant accounts record the payment against the prior year’s preschool grant
